source_version_policy: New immutable commit/bytes/checksums, preserve old attempts and report editions, new explicit authorization for a new scientific assessment

cases.validation: New immutable source version with content-hash/run/save/invocation binding; resolve duplicate roles and noise5 endpoints; do not accept folder/time/step alone
cases.regenerate: Separately authorized versioned S10 qualification/join ledger; only then affected report facts/claims/source figures; preserve existing S11 edition

cases.validation: Exact source commit, cohort/split manifest identities, loss/mask/aggregation/rank semantics and actual evaluation effort
cases.regenerate: Affected versioned S10 semantics/qualification/comparability decisions, then dependent reporting artifacts

cases.validation: Actual target/reference task/cohort/split/protocol/readout compatibility, immutable identities and explicit uncertainty meaning
cases.regenerate: Eligible reference-specific S10 joins/views and dependent report claims; no parent substitution or invented pairing

cases.validation: Exact checkpoint/hook/representation/task/readout/split/metric/denominator/implementation and allowed uncertainty; gradientnorms/global replication prohibited
cases.regenerate: New source/claim-specific S10 integration and reporting; define actual grid before denominators

affected: Only claims/joins/figures dependent on its stable source ID/version
cases.validation: Preserve original bytes/version; bind replacement bytes, immutable revision/checksums and supersession reason; reverify changed scope and scientific eligibility
cases.regenerate: Affected S10 records/report edition only; source-to-claim invalidation map. Upstream retain discrepancy blocks affected claims rather than silent scientific repair in reporting
